blocks.heading: USAA and Military Financial Services
paragraphs: USAA (San Antonio HQ) is America's most trusted financial services company — serving 13 million military members, veterans, and their families with banking, insurance, investment, and retirement products:

Military family financial analytics: ML for USAA's unique customer base — military deployment patterns, frequent relocation, VA benefits integration, and the specific financial needs of active-duty military families that standard retail banking analytics doesn't capture.

Auto insurance claims AI: Claims processing ML for USAA's large auto insurance portfolio — fraud detection, damage assessment, and claims triage for USAA's member base with higher average vehicle claims than the general population.

Military transition analytics: ML for USAA's members transitioning from active duty to civilian careers — predicting financial product needs, income disruption risk, and benefit optimization recommendations during military-to-civilian transitions.
Cost: $45,000–$125,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | Military consumer protection

blocks.heading: Healthcare (Military and Civilian)
paragraphs: University Health System (SA, Texas Level I trauma center), Baptist Health System, and Brooke Army Medical Center (Fort Sam Houston):

Military trauma AI: Clinical AI for BAMC's world-class military trauma program — injury pattern prediction, treatment protocol optimization, and outcome analytics for combat casualty care (commercial AI supporting the military trauma research mission).
University Health System clinical AI: Population health and clinical decision support for San Antonio's public hospital serving Bexar County's large Medicaid and uninsured population.

Hispanic health analytics: San Antonio is 65% Hispanic — clinical AI must incorporate Spanish language capability and culturally-aware care gap identification for SA's large Hispanic patient community.
Cost: $50,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA, Spanish language

blocks.heading: Toyota Texas Manufacturing
paragraphs: Toyota's San Antonio manufacturing plant (Tundra and Tacoma trucks — the Tundra is exclusively built in San Antonio) is one of Toyota's most significant North American facilities:

Vehicle assembly quality inspection: CV for Toyota's San Antonio body shop and final assembly — paint quality detection, exterior panel inspection, and interior trim assembly verification at production line speed.

Supply chain analytics: Demand forecasting and supplier performance ML for Toyota's San Antonio supply chain — particularly relevant for the large Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers clustered around Toyota's SA facility.
Predictive maintenance: Stamping press, paint booth, and assembly robot maintenance prediction from equipment telemetry.
Cost: $50,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | Toyota Production System context

blocks.heading: Cybersecurity
paragraphs: San Antonio is one of the US's most significant cybersecurity markets — the combination of JBSA's intelligence and cyber operations, the National Security Agency's Texas Cryptologic Center (San Antonio suburb), and the large cybersecurity defense contractors creates a commercial cybersecurity AI ecosystem:
Security operations analytics: ML for SIEM alert triage, threat hunting, and incident correlation for San Antonio's large cybersecurity employer community.
Vulnerability management: ML prioritizing vulnerability remediation for San Antonio's large IT organization community serving JBSA's and USAA's technology environments.
Cost: $35,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | Commercial scope
